steps.text: A knight softly sighs on the terrace of a Kjerag bar.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Harsh winds these days, friend. Best you don't stay out there too long.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Something up? Why all the sighs? Aren't you on vacation?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Ah... I'm fine.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I've been in Kjerag for just a few days now, but whenever I'm outside, kids circle up to point and laugh at me. Little tiring is all.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Haha, they don't mean anything by it. You're a Kazimierzian knight, no?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Some of your people've been showing off in Kjerag recently, and the kids want to try on your armor.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: This standard issue competition armor? It's not exactly high-end stuff...

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Competition...? Are you here for the Black Knight, maybe?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Oh? You know the Black Knight?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Of course. All Kjerag knows her. Couldn't find you a single soul here who hasn't met her.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: What is she into? Or what makes her angry? What does she actually care about?!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...I'm actually a fan. I want to know everything about her.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Settle down, fella. Ask away, I know her well enough.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: If she weren't so busy I'd figure a way to let you meet her, even.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: What keeps somebody busy in Kjerag?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Don't believe the foreign nonsense, 'Kjerag's so poor it only has snow' now, you hear?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Look at the newly built streets out there. Kjerag is changing by the day, and we have lots of places needing more hands.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: It's true some spots are still a little poor, but one day, each and every one of Kjeragandr's people will rise up from the valleys.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: But that time isn't now, is it?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Heheh, that's where you're wrong. Now, when everything's starting up, is the most interesting of times.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: So you're telling me, the legendary Black Knight has been busy laying bricks in Kjerag?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Uh... Actually, I haven't a clue what she's been up to lately.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: I haven't seen her in the city for a while now. Been a while since our last chat.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Sounds like you aren't that close to her.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: It would seem that way...
Another sigh on the terrace.
Truth be told, I met the Black Knight yesterday. It was our second meeting.
Many years ago when I had just become a competition knight, the General Chamber told me my debut fight wouldn't be in the arena.
They wanted us to rush over to the city outskirts, to intercept and prevent a determined and unstoppable warrior from leaving.
Fortunately, the younger me only happened to spot her from afar, before she kicked a little rock in my direction, hitting me square in the head.
I woke up in the hospital and eavesdropped on the gossiping nurses, where I learned the others had gotten hit by her greatsword instead.
And their fates were beyond miserable.

a.text: It was then that I knew, the Black Knight would be the focus of my life—
My goal, is to defeat her.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What exactly do you want?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Heh heh. I didn't think you'd remember me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But you've been dallying here for so long, you're interrupting my work.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Then let me tell you of a young knight, many years ago, on the outskirts of Kazimierz—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Put the fowlbeasts down first!
Degenbrecher stops in her tracks and sizes up Chilly Knight. In her arms rest four or five fowlbeasts, with many more scurrying around her on the ground, letting out the occasional cry.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...Never mind. I'll keep it brief.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Because of you, I've endured years of humiliation and hardship. I finally made a name for myself in the arena, becoming a well-known knight with a string of victories under my belt.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: All for one reason: a real match against you, here and now!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...You even brought a camera with you?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Afraid I'll capture the Black Knight's pathetic defeat? Heh—

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Draw your greatsword! I'll take it you accept my challenge so long as you brandish it!
She... looks away? Before the Chilly Knight can even wonder why, Degenbrecher suddenly bends down to scoop up a fowlbeast that has dashed over to her feet.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You should go. Stop bothering me with this nonsense.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I didn't think 'The Black Knight of Kazimierz' would refuse a fight...

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Did the Darksteels wound your courage along with your body?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: A fight? Each and every one of you comes with cameras in hand. I suspect you're just trying to get some B-roll for your commercials.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm retired, so think whatever you want. Don't get in my way.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: So... you're just willingly staying here in the depths of this old forest, following orders and doing pointless busywork?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Any stalwart local could deal with these runaway fowlbeasts.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Don't we competition knights... no, don't all warriors exist to duel and push ourselves to the limit?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Are you done?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Let me through.
While Chilly Knight is busy rambling away, Degenbrecher has managed to capture all the fowlbeasts, and briskly walks past her agitated visitor without even returning a glance.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...I'll bring your true self back! You will draw your blade, Black Knight!

spans.text: ...I'll bring your true self back! You

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher—I-I finally found—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Calm down. Did Hans wander off again?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Hans?

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: Phew... Of course you'd know!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'll look for him once I'm done returning these fowlbeasts. Give me a moment.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Your grandson lost or something?

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: What? Grandson? Hans is my outpost burdenbeast.
To such a trivial matter, the Black Knight nods with a smile. As he thinks about the cold and dismissive attitude she showed him...
Chilly Knight clenches his fists.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Kurwa!
The sudden display of anger startles the barkeep, drawing the other customers' curious looks.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...Sorry, sorry. I lost my cool.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: All good. I don't even know what that 'coo-vah' means.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Many tourists come to Kjerag just to let off steam, you know? Run off into the mountains, yell their hearts out. Why not give it a try?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: But the Black Knight lingers on my mind... Right, do you know anything else about her?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Hm, let me think... Many years ago, when she was still new here, the old boss would ask her for help whenever we had too many supplies to deal with.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: I was just a nobody who helped out with odd jobs then, and had no inkling of her foreign fame. But one night...

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: Yo, you're the knight or whatever they were talking about?

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: A guy here told me you could drink from dusk till dawn, and still manage to walk straight back home.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...Who told you that?

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: Don't you worry about it. We're not going to give up our rep just yet, so don't even think about leaving the place if you can't drink past us!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I have one condition: All of you write down your home addresses on a piece of paper first.

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: Easy!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Wait, what did she want with their addresses?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Slow down, pal.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Those punks regretted the challenge after the first mug. Degenbrecher finished a bottle in two chugs without even pausing.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: They started to play dirty, saying they'd take turns against the Black Knight, but she was downing mug after mug for two hours straight.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: By then, all the drunken louts were passed out on the floor, and she carried them back to the outpost.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Only then did I realize what she wanted the addresses for. No one ever dared to bother her like that again. Haha.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...An incredible story, but that doesn't tell me about her interests or character.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Don't you get it? She loves booze most of all! How else would she have won the drinking contest?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Hah, just listen to him babble. The man is practically a stranger to her.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: *sigh* Fine, if you're so chummy with her, share some wisdom, will you?

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: I sure will!

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Listen to me, buddy. Know what Degenbrecher loves the most?

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Angling.

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher, you've been here for almost a whole day now.

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: It's fine to go back empty handed. This is your second try at fincatching after all.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No, I haven't...

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Come on now, I'll give you some lures next time, you'll surely—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Quiet!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The pole moved.
Degenbrecher wields the rod as coolly as if it were a blade in her hands. She holds her breath, then swiftly flicks upward—
Only the hook remains on the line, with the bait nowhere to be seen.

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Ah, don't worry about it. There's always next time.

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Madam?!

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: ...When she emerged from the lake holding a huge finbeast, she won all of our respect.

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: After all, someone who never fails to catch is someone we can ask for the occasional spare meat.

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Of course, she eventually improved her angling skills, but that's a story for another time.

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: Nuh-uh!

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: When did you get in here, girl? Out with you!

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: Let me finish! I've seen Degenbrecher releasing the fins she caught back into the lake.

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: She loves all the little animals here.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Surely she likes hunting more?

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: No, no!

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: Degenbrecher!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Are your parents out?

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: Uh, are you looking for them?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...I was passing by and remembered delivering some medicine here three months ago. For your sickly baby cystybeast.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Is it better now?

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: Yeah... oh, careful—
A cystybeast charges straight for Degenbrecher—then shakes its head in pain as she remains completely still.
The shocked girl watches as Degenbrecher crouches down to stroke the cystybeast's neck, and gradually calms it down.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...It's grown so big in such a short time.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm glad.

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: Ever seen somebody get rammed by a cystybeast and shrug it off like nothing happened?

steps.name: Local Girl
steps.text: She comforted it for a good while, and even reminded me to feed it when she left.

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Heh, you're belittling her with the animal lover talk.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: You think the same? Exactly, how could the Black Knight possibly be into such things!

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Degenbrecher has a secret only a select few know.

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher?

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: What are you doing sitting in the snow?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I have a rare pocket of spare time today, so I wanted to find a quiet place to relax.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If there's nothing you need my help with—

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Ah, of course.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I know! She was practicing her swordplay in the snow, yearning to return to her competition days, but she didn't want to show off to the locals.

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Then, what...?

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: I'm sure of it—

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: She was ready to become a follower of Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Thank Kjeragandr, for Degenbrecher is definitely one of us.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Wait, what does that have to do with your Kjeragandr?

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Kjeragandr taught us that meditating in the snowy mountains is a way to attain wisdom.

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: Even a woman as remarkable as Degenbrecher is sure to find new insights this way.

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: So, young man. If you wish to understand Degenbrecher, you ought to study Kjerag's culture.
In the dark of night, the crowd has long gone home, leaving only the barkeep wiping down glasses as Chilly Knight remains seated by the window, in silence.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Didn't get your answer?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...I prepared for over a decade, just to defeat the Black Knight.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: News spread about how she showed her might to the Victorians, so I decided to rush over to Kjerag immediately after my arena fights.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I didn't expect the invincible Black Knight to be reduced to a country bumpkin, displaying only the most trivial of interests.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I suppose the talk of her facing the Victorians was just baseless gossip spread by troublemakers.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: What makes you say that? I wasn't there myself, but there were plenty of witnesses. Why not go ask around again—

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Save it!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...Sorry, but I haven't heard a shred of truth from anyone here the past few days.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: A warrior's obsession may seem strange to outsiders, but I won't force you to understand either.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Since the Black Knight has willingly shed her glory, I'll take my leave. Thank you for your hospitality.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: But come on, friend. Look at the weather outside. That's Kjerag for 'incoming blizzard'.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Why not stay one more night? I'll give you a discount with a bottle on the house, so you can leave Kjerag with a good impression.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: A plain old blizzard isn't much to me. I'm used to navigating harsh weather.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Well, you don't know the blizzards here often come with avalanches.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: So how do you deal with them? I'll learn.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Deal? Haha. We just accept our fates, save for Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: It's been a few years since Karlan Trade installed a warning system. Now they ban people from going up the mountain when they detect a potential avalanche.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: But she doesn't care. The worse the weather, the deeper into the mountains she goes, to see which one's making trouble.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: She'll find the right spot, and with a few huffs at the falling snow, everything's settled in a blink.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: I was lucky enough to witness it twice. Heheheh. Much more exciting than watching recordings of her fights in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: So you mean, she drew her greatsword and countered the avalanche with her martial prowess?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Sword? I don't know what method exactly, but she did look all ready to fight.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: ...Are you pulling my leg?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Hmph! I swear by Kjeragandr, it's all true!

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: May She bury me in the snow if I utter a single lie! So deep that Degenbrecher can't find me!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Then—

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Do you have any mountaineering gear here, sir?

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: What, you don't wanna leave anymore?
Chilly Knight turns around to look out the window, towards the distant snow-capped peaks merging with the dark clouds into a vast haze.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I changed my mind.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Kjerag is indeed a wonderful place.
The blizzard descends. Every household in Kjerag bolts their doors and windows shut, ready to weather Kjeragandr's ordeal.
Among the snow-covered mounts is but a single soul still wandering the peaks.
This is a rare 'break' for Degenbrecher, all along on a winding mountain path with no one else in sight. The cold and wind only help to clear her mind.
She lifts her head, waiting for an opportunity.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Here it comes.
She quickens her steps, leaving a trail of footprints going forward. Her heels halt beneath blocks of snow shaking atop a single solitary peak.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Heh—
A snow block falls, and she steps forward, drawing the dual degenbrechers at her waist, she aggressively swings at a waterfall of snow, turning it into tiny snowflakes behind her.
Until she sees within the falling snow... a dark figure, dropping down from on high.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What?!
Shortly after, a muffled, yet familiar voice comes from the snow.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Kurwa!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Pfft, bleh, argh!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: My helmet's full of snow now *cough* Skurwysyny Kjerag!

spans.text: My helmet's full of snow now *cough*

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You again.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I didn't think I'd hear Kazimierzian profanity here...
Chilly Knight is still shaking the snow off his body as he turns to the source of the voice—the Degenbrecher he was hoping to find, with weapons in hand.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: The Black Knight!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I knew you'd return. Now this is the real you!
Degenbrecher looks at her own weapons and realizes something.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea now...

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I, Chilly Knight, with—Kjeragandr as my witness, accept your challenge!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: May your blade be swift!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Where's that greatsword of yours?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Why the two sticks?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm in no mood for your attempt at comedy.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Was that avalanche your doing?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Pretty good! Yes, that was me!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: An outsider and troublemaker starting an avalanche is perhaps reason enough to wield my degenbrechers.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: We may be surrounded by snow, but falling all the way down from such a height will leave you injured.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: A flesh wound won't stop me.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I waited over a decade for this moment, and any flaws in my plan can be patched afterward. The whole of Kazimierz will know of my valiant victory over the Black Knight!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You have a death wish, then.
As Chilly Knight presses record on his camera, the Black Knight leaps forward, swinging her weapons as she did years ago.
Their weapons clash repeatedly as Degenbrecher forces her challenger down to the foot of the small mountain. Chilly Knight grits his teeth, and leaps up from the dead end he was forced into—
His opponent's slightly late swing smashes into the mountain, sending rock flying everywhere.
She follows up with a kick, sending a small stone flying at Chilly Knight, as she had many years ago on the outskirts of Kazimierz. He flicks his blade, slicing it into two.
The knight walks back up the mountain as Degenbrecher returns to a fighting stance as they face each other once more.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I'm not the only one who remembers that fateful day.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Our first meeting. On the outskirts of Kazimierz, you kicked some rubble in my direction and struck me in the head.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Haha. Even if your actions have just betrayed your thoughts?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Unfortunately, in the days since we last met, I've become more than an easy target for you to manipulate at will.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: I'll send this next strike straight through your heart!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You won't.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You turned an avalanche into a farce.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Immersing yourself in delusion for too long will only dull your mind.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Hahahaha. The Black Knight dares to boast of force! This is truly—
A faint rumble interrupts his sentence. The knight looks up, and realizes their fight has triggered a new avalanche. A waterfall of snow crashes down with boulders in tow.
Stones collide with metal, and a few momentary muffled screams follow, leaving Chilly Knight collapsed on the ground and submerged in snow.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... I expected no less of a three-time champion.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Could the tournaments be easier now than they once were...?

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Becoming a victim of the Black Knight's blade—rods, I mean, is my honor.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You don't deserve death.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But Kjerag will no longer welcome you after deliberately causing an avalanche. You'll be exiled.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: No, wait.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: You're still so powerful, even now, Black Knight. If you return to Kazimierz, you can claim back your championship title at will.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: You might not know it, but the competition scene has been declining ever since the Radiant Knight retired. There are many looking forward to your return. The General Chamber of Commerce has even issued a statement that they're willing to make some concessions for you.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I already told you, I'm retired. No matter what Kazimierz offers me, I'm not going back.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: But... alright, say Kazimierz's out of the question. There are many more places that could use your might.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: So why here? There's nothing but snow and mountains!

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Even a man as foolish as I knows a warrior's life only sees value from fighting for as long as we can.

steps.name: Chilly Knight
steps.text: Are you so content to waste your life in Kjerag? Could it be, you actually believe the nonsense written in those scriptures? *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...That's enough. Save your energy.
What is the value of a Leithanian who cannot use Arts?
Degenbrecher had no answer for this, and so she took her scrappy equipment all the way to Kazimierz. There and then, she thought the 'Glorious Land of the Knights' could give her an answer.
It was rare for her to experience failure, even in her younger days, and her successive victories only solidified her belief that the answer lay in a future arena.
Until she reached the peak with no one left to fight, and no meaningful answers either.
Some Kazimierzians told her, enjoying opulence is what drives them. Her desires would outgrow what she could gain.
Trying to understand this took more energy than her actual fights. All her experiences only made her certain that in the end the so-called 'excellent life' was absolutely boring.
Any grand pretense was only born from the desire to continue living, striving to spice up a boring life.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...No, the most important thing I gained in Kazimierz was the refusal to believe in any lofty ideals.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: When I realized Kazimierz only gave me egregiously packaged vanity, I chose to leave.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: As for the 'pure duel' you lot love to talk about... I only found it when I first faced off against an avalanche here.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: When I rescued avalanche victims off the mountains, I knew that is where I'd stay.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So if you can't get this into your head—
The competition knight is nowhere to be seen, replaced by a mysterious, crude 'snowman'.
Degenbrecher softly sighs, and knocks away the snowman's head, revealing a familiar metal helmet.
There is no response, but warm steam escaping from the helmet vents indicates the presence of life within.
As usual, the locals wait for Degenbrecher to return from the mountain where the avalanche occurred, but today she comes back with a man on her shoulder.

steps.name: Excited Local
steps.text: Glad you're late, Madam. I bet my friends you wouldn't be on time today.

steps.name: Pious Local
steps.text: It's best not to mess with an avalanche at all. Kjeragandr's wrath is not so easy to forecast.
Degenbrecher nods. Perhaps she has not noticed it, but she has long since grown used to responding to the locals' concern for her wellbeing.

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher!

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: Thank you for finding Hans. Now we're back to business.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Perfect, I just so happen to need this man sent to the station. Get him back to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That's where he belongs.
